metric_definition: per-image Dice/IoU/precision/recall, threshold 0.5, frozen phase21 definition
minimum_compatible_future_amendment: append-only events.jsonl written by the launcher/driver (epoch start/end, resume, release digest, GPU peak memory) without changing the trainer's scientific path
producer_gaps: predicted masks and surface metrics (HD95/ASSD) are not persisted
per-image metrics exist only for the selected best epoch
explicit resume/interruption events are not recorded (continuity is inferred from epoch files)
per-epoch wall-clock and GPU peak memory are not recorded (only cumulative active_seconds)
launching release identity is not stored in the checkpoint

resume_continuity.note: repeated commits of one epoch indicate a replay after interruption; explicit resume events are not recorded
